findings.title: Account save missing ownership verification

evidence.why: ID comes from request model binding (form/body), not verified against session user
No ownership check (e.g. WHERE user_id = ?) before save

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /account/save with account.id set to User B's ID and modifies the data.
findings.impact: Modify another customer's account details (name, email, etc.).
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification in the DAO or controller to ensure the account belongs to the current user before saving.

findings.title: Account rename missing ownership verification

evidence.why: ID comes from request model binding (form), not verified against session user
No ownership check (e.g. WHERE user_id = ?) before rename

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /account/rename with form.id set to User B's ID and a new name.
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification in the DAO or controller to ensure the account belongs to the current user before renaming.

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends PUT /account/api with account.id set to User B's ID and modified data.

findings.title: Admin user delete missing role check

evidence.why: No @PreAuthorize annotation restricting access to ADMIN role
Allows deletion of any user ID without verifying admin status or ownership

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /admin/users/{id}/delete with User B's ID. If no role check, User A can delete User B.
findings.impact: Delete another user's account (Privilege Escalation / BOLA).
findings.recommendation: Add @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") to restrict access to authorized administrators only.

evidence.code: public String show(@PathVariable("id") Long id, Model model) {
evidence.why: ID comes from path parameter, not verified against session user
No ownership check (e.g. findByIdAndOwner) before returning data

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /invoices/{id} with User B's Invoice ID.
findings.impact: Read another customer's invoice details (amount, items, etc.).
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification in the DAO or controller to ensure the invoice belongs to the current user before returning data.

findings.title: Order view missing ownership verification

evidence.code: ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = '" + id + "'");
evidence.why: No ownership check (e.g. AND user_id = ?) in SQL query

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /order/view?orderId=<User B's Order ID>.
findings.impact: Read another customer's order details (items, address, etc.).
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification in the query to ensure the order belongs to the current user before returning data.

findings.title: Admin user delete missing role check

evidence.why: No role check (e.g. requireAdmin) before deletion

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /admin/users/:id/delete with User B's ID. If no role check, User A can delete User B.
findings.impact: Delete another user's account (Privilege Escalation / BOLA).
findings.recommendation: Add role check middleware (e.g. requireAdmin) to restrict access to authorized administrators only.

findings.title: Report export missing role check

evidence.why: Only checks query param for isAdmin, does not verify user role

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends GET /reports/export?isAdmin=false. If no role check, User A can export all data.
findings.impact: Export all users' data (including other customers).
findings.recommendation: Add role check middleware (e.g. requireAdmin) to restrict access to authorized administrators only.
